verdict.rationale: Ghostty documents a built-in AppleScript dictionary for scripting windows, tabs, terminals, layouts and input events. That is real-language scripting beyond config options, but it is macOS-only and is not an in-terminal plugin or extension system. Otherwise extensibility is limited to configuration, keybindings and themes, and a hands-on runtime probe found that the CLI exposes only config and +actions with no remote-control/IPC surface; libghostty is for building new terminals rather than extending Ghostty. Missing for 10: a plugin/extension API, Lua/Python or kitten-style scripting, cross-platform (Linux) scripting, hands-on corroboration that AppleScript automation works.
